ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the oath by the pen in Surah Al-Qalam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath underscores the divine origin of the Quran by contrasting the precision of the pen with the chaotic ignorance of the disbelievers, affirming the Prophet's moral integrity. It establishes writing as a sacred instrument for preserving revelation and transmitting knowledge, a concept central to the Shia emphasis on the preservation of the Imamate's teachings.
